max_clause.text: **Minimizing harm:** Like any system that interacts with hundreds of millions of users, AI systems also carry potential risks for harm. Parts of the Model Spec consist of rules aimed at minimizing these risks. Not all risks from AI can be mitigated through model behavior alone; the Model Spec is just one component of our overall safety strategy.
